programs.title: The Real Prime Suspect
programs.sub_title: A Secret Life and Public Death
programs.desc: Jackie Malton re-examines the death of Danny Denbury, talking to police officers who worked on the case of a much-loved local man who led a secret life.

programs.title: The Fifth Estate
programs.sub_title: Abandoned in Afghanistan: Canada's Failed Promise
programs.desc: Gillian Findlay looks at the effort mounted by Canadian military veterans to get former interpreters out of Afghanistan and reveals tensions within Canada's government about how to proceed.

programs.title: Dead Man's Switch: A Crypto Mystery
programs.desc: A thirty-year-old CEO responsible for hundreds of millions of dollars in cryptocurrency and cash dies suddenly in India and $215M disappears, kicking off a major scandal and fueling speculation that his exit was only one of many scams.

programs.title: Still Standing
programs.desc: After the town's uranium mine went bust, Elliot Lake turned to of another precious resource: some of the most affordable real estate in the country.

programs.title: The Nature of Things
programs.desc: Dogs using buttons to communicate in our language have gone viral; owners and scientists dive deeper; can dogs truly talk to us?
